name: Carolina Metal Fabricators
old_description: One of the most advanced fabrication companies on the East Coast that specializes in both structural and miscellaneous steel for the industrial sectors.  The technology we employ through both software and machinery allows us to get your fabrication delivered quickly to the job site with 100% accuracy.  We pride ourselves on being the fabricator of choice for all industrial segments along the East Coast.
about:
Carolina Metal Fabricators operates from Raleigh, North Carolina, providing structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication for industrial clients across the East Coast. The company emphasizes advanced technology, including software-driven machinery and robotic systems, to achieve accurate and timely delivery to job sites.

The shop focuses on plate fabrication and the processing of various alloys, utilizing a streamlined facility staffed by experienced craftsmen. Its equipment lineup features cutting-edge robotics, which the company describes as among the most advanced on the East Coast, supporting both structural and miscellaneous steel projects.

The company serves a broad range of industrial sectors, positioning itself as a fabricator of choice for industrial segments along the East Coast. Customer types include industrial contractors and manufacturers requiring structural steel components and miscellaneous metalwork.

Carolina Metal Fabricators differentiates itself through its investment in proprietary software and robotic machinery, which it says enables quick turnaround with 100 percent dimensional accuracy. The firm was founded on the premise that technology-driven fabrication can reduce lead times while maintaining quality for demanding industrial applications.
